question: Is the dominant left-tail damage in ASYM-BETA-0022 primarily an intra-refit latency problem: do already-defined trend, downside-semivolatility and raw-state p_bad diagnostics weaken materially inside the 30-day holding interval before the next BRRK refit?
authorized_by: ASYM-BETA-0022 dominant drawdown attribution: incremental damage concentrated in April and June 2024 while the overlay was sized only at monthly refits.

frozen_monthly_reference.core: corrected BRRK-0011 monthly core authority unchanged

daily_diagnostics_only.hmm_refit: NO daily refit. Keep each monthly fitted HMM fixed until the next scheduled refit.
daily_diagnostics_only.state_risk_distribution: Keep the monthly raw-state V1 conditional-risk distribution frozen until the next refit.
daily_diagnostics_only.daily_posterior: Update only the causal filtered raw-state posterior each completed day under the frozen monthly HMM.
daily_diagnostics_only.daily_p_bad: Posterior-weighted probability of negative conditional V1 mean using the frozen monthly state-risk distribution.
daily_diagnostics_only.daily_trend: Use the existing completed-day BTC trend_score from the frozen feature definition.
daily_diagnostics_only.daily_downside_semivol: Use the existing 30-day downside-semivol definition from ASYM-BETA-0022.
daily_diagnostics_only.daily_implied_extra: Re-evaluate the already-frozen 0022 arithmetic using daily trend, daily p_bad and daily downside semivol, while monthly BRRK core permission remains frozen. This is a diagnostic shadow value only; no returns are generated from trading it.

required_outputs: one row per completed day with monthly held extra and daily implied extra
daily trend, p_bad, downside semivol and downside scaler
gap = monthly held extra - daily implied extra
aggregate excess-exposure days during all active monthly intervals
episode summaries for the known 2024-04 and 2024-06 damage windows
date and component attribution for the first material weakening inside each active interval
all active intervals ranked by average and maximum held-minus-implied gap

material_weakening_diagnostics.purpose: Descriptive latency reporting only. These ratios do not authorize trading thresholds and will not be optimized.

prohibited: no alternative semivol windows or anchors
no alternative p_bad transform or threshold
no actual daily-overlay backtest under this audit ID
no claim that a favorable latency diagnostic proves a daily trading rule
next_experiment_rule: Only if already-defined daily diagnostics materially weaken before the dominant monthly-overlay loss windows may a separately preregistered experiment test faster refresh of overlay risk authority. The next experiment must preserve BRRK core, the 0022 candidate-extra formula, gross cap and all other frozen parameters.
